stance: Conditional watch — verify cash collection and financing before upgrading the thesis
question: Can the year-end delivery ramp improve equity economics faster than interest, refinancing and dilution consume it?
takeaway: FY guidance requires Q4 revenue of $4.686–4.986B, 28–36% above Q3. Yet implied Q4 adjusted operating income of $747–847M remains below guided interest of $1.05–1.15B. A strong revenue quarter alone does not establish an attractive equity trade. The key confirmation is collected customer cash and funded delivery with acceptable per-share economics.
valuation_note: November 24 close: $42.61 (dated provider observation, not live). October 30 basic economic shares: 556,125,724 across Classes A/B/C; price × those older shares ≈ $23.697B, close to provider $23.69B but not proof of a current denominator. A historical claims bridge using September 30 principal debt $47.505B, finance leases $0.649B and cash $4.122B gives EV = 0.556125724 × price + $44.032B (billions); ≈ $67.729B at that dated price. This excludes operating leases under a rent-expensed convention, excludes restricted cash and requires subsequent-financing reconciliation. Do not compare it with a vendor EV using different lease treatment. No supported fair-value target or consensus surprise estimate is available.

cases.name: Bull
cases.thesis: Delivery and customer cash collection reduce financing uncertainty enough to support a rerating, even before GAAP profitability. This is a conditional interpretation, not a probability forecast.
cases.requires: Revenue and December run rate support FY $13.0–13.3B and exit ARR $20–21B; active power exceeds 1.85GW; management confirms meaningful receipt of the expected $9B customer funds and funded capex on terms that preserve per-share upside.
cases.invalidated_by: FY revenue below $13B or exit ARR below $20B without a documented timing recovery; material delivery slippage; receipts delayed or restricted beyond the funding plan; issuance/refinancing terms that erase the modeled per-share improvement.

cases.name: Base
cases.thesis: Operations meet guidance, but debt service and continued construction absorb the improvement. Positive delivery news can coexist with volatile or weak equity returns.
cases.requires: Q4 revenue $4.686–4.986B and adjusted operating income $747–847M; guided interest $1.05–1.15B; no demonstrated all-in funding closure or sustainable free cash flow.
cases.invalidated_by: Upgrade if cash receipts, project financing and margin progression demonstrably improve per-share economics; downgrade if guidance is cut, financing access narrows or liquidity restrictions intensify.

cases.name: Bear
cases.thesis: Delayed collections or delivery force additional expensive capital, while high fixed financing costs amplify a relatively modest operating miss. Backlog growth alone cannot cure a near-term liquidity mismatch.
cases.requires: Evidence of missed delivery or cash timing, worsening funding terms, greater dilution, or insufficient unrestricted cash relative to near-term uses; not merely a falling stock price.
cases.invalidated_by: Verified customer receipts plus executable financing bridge through delivery, with improving operating performance and updated diluted-share economics that retain value for common equity.

checkpoints.label: UBS conference — 11:35 ET / December 2, 00:35 Singapore
checkpoints.watch: Ask for receipts collected, current funding terms and progress toward year-end delivery. Conference commentary is not audited cash evidence.
checkpoints.positive: Specific dated collections and executable financing commitments with terms.
checkpoints.negative: Repeated expectations without receipt evidence, delivery push-outs or adverse financing changes.

checkpoints.label: Year-end operating targets; results reported later
checkpoints.watch: FY revenue $13–13.3B, exit ARR $20–21B and active power above 1.85GW. ARR implies December revenue $1.667–1.750B, not full-year revenue.
checkpoints.positive: Targets delivered alongside paid service commencement and cash collection.
checkpoints.negative: Misses or apparent capacity additions without billed revenue. Absence of disclosure at year-end is not itself a miss.

checkpoints.label: Analytical check on the three-month customer-cash expectation
checkpoints.watch: Reconcile approximately $9B expected prepayments/deposits to actual receipts, restrictions and uses. Window is calculated from November 10; not a contractual due date.
checkpoints.positive: Confirmed collections and usable cash matched to construction obligations.
checkpoints.negative: Reported delays, refunds, restrictions or material funding shortfall. No disclosure means unknown, not failed.

checkpoints.label: Rebuild the financing and share bridge
checkpoints.watch: Cash flow, debt principal and maturities, project draws, ATM sales/forwards, updated share count and forward guidance. Publication may fall outside this 90-day window.
checkpoints.positive: A reconciled funded plan with improving interest coverage and defensible dilution assumptions.
checkpoints.negative: Higher recourse exposure, adverse debt terms, large unexpected share issuance or unresolved liquidity gaps.

gaps: No same-horizon, timestamped consensus or options-implied move has been verified. Meeting guidance cannot be called a positive surprise.
October 30 shares and September 30 debt/cash are historical. Current ATM use, forward settlement, debt draws and fully diluted economics are unverified.
No complete contract-by-contract funding, collateral, covenant or amortization model. Remaining 2026 principal maturities $2.433B and 2027 $10.974B do not alone establish a funding deficit.
Customer prepayments are prospective, not cash already on hand; restrictions, refunds and timing require confirmation.
Active MW is not billed utilization. GPU generation mix, realized pricing, economic replacement costs and site-specific revenue conversion remain missing.
No validated technical entry, stop, volume regime or executable spread; this fundamental brief cannot independently produce a trade ticket.

metrics.label: Implied Q4 revenue
metrics.basis: Derived: FY guidance $13.0–13.3B less nine-month actual $8.314B; +28.0–36.2% versus Q3. Not separately issued Q4 guidance.

metrics.label: Q4 adjusted operating income less interest
metrics.basis: Derived: ($1.275–1.375B FY adjusted OI − $528M nine-month actual) less $1.05–1.15B Q4 interest. Independent endpoint range; not a net-loss forecast.

metrics.label: Debt principal
metrics.basis: September 30 principal, not $46.873B carrying amount; includes recourse and non-recourse obligations.

metrics.label: Cash and equivalents
metrics.basis: September 30; excludes $2.282B restricted cash. Does not include prospective customer receipts or undrawn commitments.

metrics.label: Dated basic economic shares
metrics.basis: October 30 cover: 465,847,732 Class A + 90,277,992 Class B + zero Class C. Not current or fully diluted shares.
